bioaccumulation.translation: n. (有毒化学物质的) 生物体内积累

bioaccumulative.translation: adj. 生物累积性的；生物体内积聚的

bioactivity.translation: n. 生物活性,生物活度( 指杀虫剂等对生物体的影响)

bioaeration.translation: 生物通气, 生物充气, 生物曝气法, 活性曝气法

bioassary.translation: 生物测定; 生物检定

bioassay.definition:
n. appraisal of the biological activity of a substance by testing its effect on an organism and comparing the result with some agreed standard
v. subject to a bio-assay
bioassay.translation:
n. 生物鉴定, 活体检定, 生物测定
[化] 生物测定

bioassayed.translation: v. 给…作生物测定, 给…作生物鉴定( bioassay的过去式和过去分词 )

bioassaying.translation: v. 给…作生物测定, 给…作生物鉴定( bioassay的现在分词 )

bioassays.definition:
n appraisal of the biological activity of a substance by testing its effect on an organism and comparing the result with some agreed standard
v subject to a bio-assay

bioastrophysics.translation:
[计] 生物宇宙物理学
[化] 天体生物物理学

bioautography.translation: n. 生物自检法,生物自显影法

bioavailable.translation: a. 生物及生物药效应(bioavailable)的
